description: Invented test rules for light workshop preparation, not occupational or medical guidance.
assumptions: Location changes are instantaneous at minute boundaries.
Readiness is a separate caller assertion and is never inferred from elapsed recovery.
Future work requires rechecking worker suitability and task prerequisites.
Mandatory recovery beyond the requested horizon is reserved until the selected timing policy's initial or between-work requirement is complete.
The policy applies only to the eleven affected workers and light workshop work.
